response.note: Compares successful-order GMV for NovaMart over Oct 25-31, 2026 against settlement batches whose covered period ends in that window; the order_status value 'SUCCESS' is an assumption, and settlement timing lags may cause a gap.
response.sql: WITH txn AS (SELECT SUM(amount_inr) AS txn_gmv_inr, COUNT(*) AS txn_orders FROM v_orders WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-25' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01' AND merchant_name = 'NovaMart' AND order_status = 'SUCCESS'), stl AS (SELECT SUM(gross_amount_inr) AS settled_gross_inr, SUM(refunds_inr) AS refunds_inr, SUM(fees_inr) AS fees_inr, SUM(net_amount_inr) AS settled_net_inr, SUM(txn_count) AS settled_txn_count FROM v_settlements WHERE merchant_name = 'NovaMart' AND covered_to >= DATE '2026-10-25' AND covered_to <= DATE '2026-10-31') SELECT txn.txn_gmv_inr, txn.txn_orders, stl.settled_gross_inr, stl.refunds_inr, stl.fees_inr, stl.settled_net_inr, stl.settled_txn_count, txn.txn_gmv_inr - stl.settled_gross_inr AS gmv_vs_gross_gap_inr FROM txn CROSS JOIN stl LIMIT 50
